Patient admitted for post-acute rehab after hip fracture, now in recovery with anemia being managed
• Hip fracture — post-acute rehabilitation in progress
• Anemia — Hemoglobin 9.6, continue iron supplementation
• Hypokalemia concern — Potassium 5.9 on current labs, monitor

• Low-grade fever — Temperature 38.2°C, monitor for infection
